briefdescription.para: Performance benchmarks for AQL Phase 4 consistency hardening.

detaileddescription.para: Release Gates: AQL-ASS-01: validateAQLWithParser() ≤ 100µs (p99) AQL-ASS-02: translateNLToAQL() ≤ 500µs (p99) AQL-ASS-03: Bridge execution ≤ 1000µs (p99) AQL-ASS-04: Full pipeline ≤ 1500µs (p99)
This benchmark suite focuses on individual component performance with unified error handling semantics and consistent logging.
